issues.description: Preview contract is documented by example only with no written supertype spec.
issues.detail: The docs introduce JsonPreview, TablePreview, PlotlyPreview, MermaidPreview, ImagePreview, TextPreview, and CustomPreview without stating the abstract Preview contract: required fields, per-subtype content preconditions, to_dict() guarantees, or exception behavior. Add a Preview ADT section before the per-type sections so substitution and future subtypes are well-defined.

issues.description: preview_fn signature and error semantics are unspecified.
issues.detail: Docs say preview functions lack access to node inputs/outputs and suggest closures, but never state the required signature, async support, what node.preview() returns when preview_fn is absent, or how exceptions propagate. Best-practice item 5 says wrap in try/except without defining what kedro does on failure. Pin preconditions and postconditions explicitly.

issues.description: CustomPreview example uses Ellipsis literals that will not run as written.
issues.detail: The custom preview snippet has "nodes": [...] and "edges": [...] which produce Ellipsis objects and fail JSON serialization when copy-pasted. Either provide a minimal real node/edge payload or annotate as a fragment with a # comment. Docs examples should execute.

issues.description: ImagePreview example contains dead-code return masquerading as an alternative.
issues.detail: The function returns the URL form, then has a commented-out data URI return below the live return. Readers see two returns and one is unreachable. Split into two named functions or parameterize so the example does not teach leaving dead returns behind.

issues.description: meta is overloaded as both opaque metadata and renderer configuration.
issues.detail: Docs state meta carries contextual metadata and rendering hints (Mermaid layout, code language) through one untyped dict, leaking renderer concerns into the abstraction. Separate meta (opaque context) from a typed render_config or per-subtype field, or at minimum document the reserved keys and ownership across the kedro/kedro-viz boundary.

issues.description: Pipeline node examples are missing imports and reference undefined functions.
issues.detail: Standalone node(...) calls in Mermaid and Text sections reference process_data and calculate_metrics that are never defined and omit the from kedro.pipeline import node line. Also next(n for n in pipeline.nodes) is gratuitously clever over pipeline.nodes[0]. Make snippets runnable or mark fragments clearly.

synthesis.summary: The PR documents a new experimental preview_fn feature with a family of typed Preview subtypes, and the panel agrees the content is useful but underspecified and sloppy in places. The dominant concern is contract: the abstract Preview supertype, per-subtype content preconditions, preview_fn signature, and node.preview() error semantics are never written down, leaving substitution and extension fragile. meta is overloaded with renderer config, leaking frontend coupling. Example code also has executable defects — Ellipsis literals, dead return statements, undefined function references — that will break copy-paste. Fix the contract spec and tighten the examples before merge.
